title: Welcome to 220 Denson Ln Jarrell, TX 76537!
description:
Welcome to your future home at 220 Denson Ln in Jarrell, TX! 

This stunning property boasts 5 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and 2 living areas, offering over 2,500 sqft of modern living space. Recent updates include fresh paint and new flooring, giving it a contemporary touch. Nestled on a corner lot, you'll enjoy extra outdoor space and privacy. Plus, the community features multiple pools for endless summer fun! 🌞

Conveniently located near Jarrell, Austin, and Ft. Cavazos, this home is more than just a house; it's a lifestyle upgrade. With shopping and entertainment nearby, your leisure and convenience are guaranteed. 

Ready for a change? This home is move-in ready and waiting for you! 🌟
